identity.mission: Create a premium, 'Luminous Precision' showcase that breaks the generic SaaS template. Fusion of high-end architecture portfolio and futuristic tech dashboard.
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Architectural Minimalism with Cyberpunk nuances.
Emotion First: The site must feel 'Expensive' and 'Precise'.
Content is King: The LED products are the heroes; the UI is the theater.
Negative Space: Luxurious spacing (py-24, py-32) to let the visuals breathe.
Contrast: Deep Black (#050508) vs Electric Cyan (#22D3EE).

rules.global_override: MUST REMOVE or OVERRIDE 'text-transform: uppercase' from global CSS. Use sentence case for body and standard headings.

headings.case: Sentence Case or Title Case (NOT ALL CAPS)
headings.flair: Use 'text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-cyan-200' for key words.

labels.usage: Use ONLY for small eyebrows/tags above headings.

instructions: Fix Logo: Increase logo container height. Ensure it is not cut off. Use 'h-10 w-auto' or larger.
Simplicity: Reduce visual noise in dropdowns. Use cleaner typography.
Glassmorphism: Keep the blur but ensure contrast is high enough for readability.
Impact: Use the video background with a cleaner, darker overlay for text readability.
Typography: CHANGE headline to Sentence Case (e.g., 'Engineering Brilliance'). Remove floating icons.
CTA: Use a 'Glass' button for secondary action and a Solid Cyan button for primary.
Motion: Add a subtle scroll indicator (mouse wheel animation).

StatsSection.design: Minimalist. Remove the 'card' borders. Just large numbers + labels floating in space or separated by thin vertical dividers.
StatsSection.typography: Numbers: font-mono text-cyan-400. Labels: uppercase tracking-widest text-neutral-500.

ProductShowcase.design: Immersive Cards. Tall aspect ratio. Image fills the card. Text overlay at the bottom with a gradient fade.
ProductShowcase.interaction: Hover: Zoom image slightly, glow effect on borders.
ProductShowcase.grid: Use a masonry or asymmetrical grid if possible to break the monotony.

hero_background.description: Geometric modern architecture facade at night

css_overrides: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { text-transform: none !important; }

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a 'bg-black/50' or gradient overlay.
